title: LifeTox: Unveiling Implicit Toxicity in Life Advice
reasoning: The LifeTox dataset is fundamentally built upon the distinction between ethical and unethical behaviors. It utilizes content from subreddits dedicated to ethical living tips (r/LifeProTips) and unethical advice (r/UnethicalLifeProTips) to benchmark how models identify socially harmful or problematic behaviors, which is a direct application of machine learning to moral and ethical categorization.
